title: Fortis Healthcare appoints Ajey Maharaj as Brand Custodian
summary: The Senior Vice President and Group Head – Corporate Communications, PR & Corporate Administration takes on the additional responsibility of overseeing brand representation across the hospital network

contentHtml:
The Senior Vice President and Group Head – Corporate Communications, PR & Corporate Administration takes on the additional responsibility of overseeing brand representation across the hospital network

 Fortis Healthcare has appointed Ajey Maharaj, Senior Vice President and Group Head – Corporate Communications, PR & Corporate Administration, as Brand Custodian, assigning him the additional responsibility.

In this role, Maharaj will be responsible for protecting and strengthening the Fortis brand and ensuring its consistent representation across the hospital network and stakeholder communications. He will work with teams across the organisation to support adherence to brand guidelines.

Maharaj brings more than three decades of experience in corporate communications, reputation management and brand transformation. Since joining Fortis in December 2015, he has led the Group’s communications and PR mandate, covering media relations, crisis communication, leadership messaging, internal communications and investor-facing communication, alongside Corporate Administration.

Before joining Fortis, he headed Corporate Communications at Tata Power Delhi. His earlier experience includes roles at Bharti Tele Ventures, Reliance Energy, ABB and the Steel Authority of India.
